79767.subject: SEC Staff Draws A Line On Token Buybacks and Liquid Staking in New FAQs
79767.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[SEC staff](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-staff-clarifies-token-buybacks-and-liquid-staking-in-new-faqs)**[ drew a line on token buybacks and liquid staking receipts in new FAQs](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-staff-clarifies-token-buybacks-and-liquid-staking-in-new-faqs)

* **[The Fed](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/fed-proposes-capital-charges-and-bank-approval-rules-for-stablecoins)**[ proposed capital charges and an approval process for bank stablecoin issuers](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/fed-proposes-capital-charges-and-bank-approval-rules-for-stablecoins)

* **[Bitget](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/bitget-raises-hack-estimate-to-387-5-million-as-token-accounting-widens)**[ raised its hack estimate to $387.5 million with withdrawals still paused](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/bitget-raises-hack-estimate-to-387-5-million-as-token-accounting-widens)

* **[Aave](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-adds-coinbase-stock-tokens-as-collateral-on-base)**[ opened USDC borrowing against seven Coinbase stock tokens on Base](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-adds-coinbase-stock-tokens-as-collateral-on-base)

* **[Ethena](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-starts-equity-basis-rollout-for-usde-with-binance)**[ started backing USDe with equity basis trades on Binance](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-starts-equity-basis-rollout-for-usde-with-binance)

The SEC’s **Division of Corporation Finance** [announced buybacks of non-security tokens on a functional crypto system does not by itself promise essential managerial efforts](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-staff-clarifies-token-buybacks-and-liquid-staking-in-new-faqs), the element that turns a token into an investment contract under Howey. A network still short of functional gets a different answer if the issuer pitches the buyback as yield for holders. The same FAQs treat qualifying liquid staking receipts as non-securities, provided the issuer cannot lend, pledge or otherwise use the deposited asset.

None of it binds the Commission. The staff says the published FAQ carries "no legal force or effect," and the Commission has neither approved nor disapproved them.

**Read more below!**

Two stock-token models picked up new jobs on Friday: Coinbase's tokens became Aave collateral, and Binance's bStocks started backing USDe. **Camila Russo** put the question under both to Cooley's **Rodrigo Seira**, Dinari's **Gabriel Otte** and Ondo's **Peter Curley**: should a tokenized stock track the price, or be a claim on the share? **[Watch the full conversation.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIMVROBpfEM)**

## Higgsfield hit $1B in annualized revenue and the CEO open sourced it

Caption: 

Alex Mashrabov, CEO of Higgsfield, said: "Go build your own Higgsfield."

Higgsfield announced it [passed $1B in annualized revenue](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/genai-works_he-dared-developers-to-build-a-competitor-activity-7508945206172352512-WIMe?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAADYDGbYBqRpyEhJDclFhv_HP4xWNi_GULV8), 18 months after launch.

Faster than the AI coding platforms that kicked off this wave.

What's open:

→ Its pipelines, skills and models through one API

→ SDKs, a CLI and plugins under MIT and Apache licenses

→ API pricing that's cheaper than the subscription, with up to 50% off some models

→ A $50,000 bounty from one of his team members for anyone who builds a useful competitor on it

What's behind the $1B:

→ 390 of the Fortune 500 run campaigns on it

→ Enterprise adoption up 10x since June, over 100% month over month

→ Fastest-growing image and video AI vendor in Ramp's spend data, with more customers switching to it than to anyone else in the category

→ One platform picking the route across 35+ image, video, audio and LLM models, including its own

→ Agencies cutting production costs by up to 97% and time by 79%

So it’s less of a giveaway and more of luring competitors in and getting them to pay Higgsfield more money. They keep making the smartest moves around. What do you think?
